findings.evidence: governance/runtime/ACTIVE_TASK.json:17 requires a real PostgreSQL 17 empty-db, V047-upgrade, and SQL invariant matrix. The only real-Postgres test skips when HHY_R15_POSTGRES_DSN is absent at tests/test_r15_notification_support_postgres.py:137-139, and the SQL it runs at lines 153-156 drops the schema then executes all migrations from scratch, so it does not exercise a populated V047 upgrade path. The listed acceptance command does not require or provide that DSN.
